web_fixture.title: HL-3132 keeps recurring after every failover
web_fixture.snippet: Operators keep hitting HL-3132 (tidebreak) once a failover moves the primary; here is what the thread settled on.
web_fixture.content:
# HL-3132 keeps recurring after every failover

**posted 2026-05-30 by Marek Talvard**

After our quarterly failover drill, several replicas started returning HL-3132 within minutes. The dashboards call the condition tidebreak: the replication fence was rewritten while a follower was still applying the previous fence, so the follower drops its lease and rejoins.

We cleared it by letting each follower drain before cutting the fence again. Other teams report the same pattern on every major version since 4.0, so it is worth keeping the drain step in the drill script.

web_fixture.title: Error reference - harborlight documentation
web_fixture.snippet: Every harborlight error code with its condition name and the handling the runbook prescribes.
web_fixture.content:
# Error reference

harborlight prints errors as HL-NNNN. The condition column is the name our dashboards and runbooks use.

| Code | Condition | Meaning and handling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HL-3301 | snowline | The node lost its quorum view. Rebuild the view before rejoining. |
| HL-3132 | tidebreak | A follower applied a stale replication fence. Let the follower drain before cutting a new fence. |
| HL-3312 | moatleak | The primary's write lease and the quorum's view disagree: writes are accepted locally but never replicate. Step the primary down and let the quorum elect a new one. |
| HL-3407 | glassrun | The snapshot store is unreachable. Repair the store before retrying. |

Last reviewed 2026-08-02.
